info.title: Purolator REST APIs (merged)
info.description:
All Purolator REST services in one OpenAPI 3 document, merged from Purolator's published per-service specs (see services/). Components that differ between services carry a service prefix, e.g. Estimate_Tax.

Fixes applied to Purolator's published specs in this merged file:
- ShipmentDate: removed default "Today's Date" (not a date; the description already says it defaults to today)
- packageWeight: added minimum 0 (exclusiveMinimum had no minimum)

post.description: Trigger end-of-day close (consolidate) of the courier manifest for an account. Freight is not supported.

post.description: Create a courier outbound shipment, optional return shipment, or Returns Management (RMS) shipment. Freight is not supported.

put.description: Void a previously created courier shipment by PIN. Same resource path as Create Shipment; this operation is PUT. Freight is not supported.

bearerAuth.description: For secure access, this API uses Bearer Authentication (also known as token authentication). You must send a Bearer token in the Authorization header when making requests to protected endpoints. The token should be prefixed with the word "Bearer" followed by a space. Example: "Authorization: Bearer <YourTokenHere>".

basicAuth.description:
This API uses HTTP Basic Authentication to obtain a Bearer token. Provide your `client_id` as
the username and `client_secret` as the password, Base64-encoded in the `Authorization` header.
Example: "Authorization: Basic <base64(client_id:client_secret)>"

AWSv4Auth.description:
For authenticating requests using AWS Signature Version 4. The value of this header must be 
formed according to AWS Signature Version 4 specifications. This includes the algorithm 
identifier (AWS4-HMAC-SHA256), followed by credential scope, a list of signed headers, and 
the signature. Refer to AWS documentation for detailed instructions on forming this header.
